name: Browser Agent (uiuing)
notes: Chrome Manifest V3 extension by uiuing, first released as v0.0.1 (Chrome zip in GitHub releases). The model acts on pages only through the page_act tool, which hands a goal to an engine that builds a semantic snapshot of DOM nodes with roles, accessible names, values, occlusion, open shadow roots and same-origin iframes (packages/extension/src/engine/page/perception.ts), resolves targets by fingerprint against a fresh snapshot and fires click, input, change and key events in the page (engine/page/execute.ts). The page_screenshot tool shows a capture to the user; its description limits the model to other page information rather than the pixels (tools/page.ts). A chrome.debugger channel is used for file uploads and falls back to DOM synthesis. Tools carry read, act or dangerous risk tiers with site allow/block lists and confirmation; verified runs can be saved as skills and replayed over batch rows. Model ports cover OpenAI-compatible, OpenAI Responses and Anthropic APIs. The docs/benchmark.md comparison is publisher-run on the project's own fixtures against its own replica of a viewport-only baseline.
summary: Chrome side-panel agent whose page engine reads a whole-page semantic DOM snapshot, re-grounds targets by element fingerprints, dispatches DOM events and checks post-conditions before reporting success.
